$Comment: One of Tomas's plain errands, on his own board (Christmas_Miller_Jobs): bring him wheat for his flour.
His board posts an errand only where MMO Skill Tree is missing (the errand slot's Max 0 gate), in place
of the skill job a server running that mod posts, so every server gets one job from Tomas a day. The
band Christmas_Miller_Errand holds his two errands, and the board draws one of them each day. A TURN_IN
step is handed in at Tomas or at his board.
It pays half a Christmas Board job, the same plain pay as his skill job: Christmas Coins, a little favor
on Santa's Nice List and Festival Favor, waiting at the board until the player collects it.
The Mmo_Xp row (Harvesting XP, behind its own hytale:mod_installed gate) is there because every paying
contract in the pack carries an MMO Skill Tree row, and it pays nothing with this pack's boards: the
errand file loads on every server, but its slot is posted only where MMO Skill Tree is missing, and
there the row's gate leaves it out. It pays only if a server owner's own board posts the errand where
MMO Skill Tree runs. The season and the listing come from Christmas_Contract_Base, and its words from
the keys its id spells, in christmas.mmo.lang.
